podcast.title: Early 2000s Revival (2000-2001)
podcast.body: The "Post-Punk Revival," also known as the Indie Rock Revival, occurred around 2000-2001. This movement presented a new take on earlier alt-rock, garage rock, and punk styles, bringing sharp and clever new bands to the forefront. "We call this the Indie Rock Revival, or Post-Punk Revival."

podcast.title: End of an Era
podcast.body: The rise of the post-punk revival scene in the 2000s, featuring bands like Destro (The Strokes), Sinterpol (Interpol), de Raptor (The Hives), Transferdenano (Franz Ferdinand), and EYE-JES (The Hives/other contemporary bands), brought renewed interest in the aesthetics of previous decades. This movement marked a significant cultural shift, signaling the end of the Nu Metal era and the dominance of MTV in popular music. "marcaron el fin de la era Num Metal y el Domínio de la MTV."
